title: 大学的功能：就业技能还是知识本身
genre: 议论文 · 讨论双方观点
prompt: Some people believe that universities should provide graduates with the knowledge and skills needed in the workplace. Others think that the true function of a university should be to give access to knowledge for its own sake. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 引入
outline.purpose: 改写题目 + 亮出自己立场（不要拖到结尾才表态）

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 观点 A
outline.purpose: 承认就业导向的合理性，给出经济与个人两层理由

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 观点 B
outline.purpose: 论证纯粹求知的价值，用“不可预测性”这一角度而非空谈情怀

outline.label: 第 4 段 · 我的立场
outline.purpose: 不和稀泥：提出二者并非对立，给出可操作的整合方式

outline.label: 第 5 段 · 结尾
outline.purpose: 把问题从“选哪个”升格为“如何配比”

paragraphs.text: Universities have long been pulled in two directions: one camp insists that they equip students for the labour market, while another maintains that knowledge deserves to be pursued for its own sake. Although vocational relevance is a legitimate demand in an era of costly tuition, I would argue that a university which abandons disinterested inquiry ultimately fails even at job preparation.

notes.mark: have long been pulled in two directions
notes.note: 不要用 There is a debate about... 这类空话开头。这里用一个有画面感的比喻（被两股力量拉扯）直接建立张力。

notes.mark: one camp insists that
notes.note: one camp ... another maintains 是改写“有人认为／另一些人认为”的高级替换，避免 Some people think 的模板腔。

notes.mark: Although vocational relevance is a legitimate demand
notes.note: 先让步、承认对方合理，再转折立论。让步必须给得真诚，否则后面的反驳显得轻飘。

notes.mark: ultimately fails even at job preparation
notes.note: 全文最聪明的一句：不否定就业目标，而是论证“纯粹求知恰恰更能实现就业目标”。把对立转成了包含关系，立意立刻高一档。

paragraphs.analysis: 四句话完成三件事：重述题目、给出让步、亮明立场。注意立场句用 I would argue that 而非 I think，语气更审慎也更学术。

paragraphs.role: 观点 A · 就业导向
paragraphs.text: The case for employability is not difficult to make. Higher education now represents a substantial financial burden for most families, and it is entirely reasonable for students to expect a measurable return on that investment. Degrees in nursing, engineering and accountancy owe their value precisely to the specific competencies they certify. A graduate who cannot translate three years of study into any marketable capability has, in a very practical sense, been let down by the institution.

notes.mark: The case for employability is not difficult to make.
notes.note: the case for X 起段，比 Firstly, there are many advantages 紧凑得多。这一句同时充当主题句和过渡句。

notes.mark: a measurable return on that investment
notes.note: 把抽象的“值不值”具体成经济学词汇 return on investment，用词精准是拿高分的关键。

notes.mark: owe their value precisely to
notes.note: owe A to B＝A 归功于 B。加 precisely 使因果更锋利。

notes.mark: has, in a very practical sense, been let down by the institution
notes.note: 插入语 in a very practical sense 限定了断言的范围，避免绝对化；同时句式变化打破了单调的主谓宾节奏。

paragraphs.analysis: 论证走的是“成本—回报”这条最硬的线，并落到 nursing / engineering / accountancy 三个具体专业。抽象论点必须落到具体名词上，否则说服力为零。

paragraphs.role: 观点 B · 求知本身
paragraphs.text: Yet an exclusively utilitarian curriculum rests on a shaky assumption: that we can foresee which skills will matter. History suggests otherwise. Many of the competencies most prized today—data interpretation, cross-cultural communication, ethical reasoning about technology—were nowhere on any syllabus a generation ago. What survives such churn is not any particular technique but the trained capacity to read closely, weigh evidence and reason under uncertainty, and these are cultivated most reliably by subjects that answer to no immediate employer.

notes.mark: rests on a shaky assumption
notes.note: 驳论的标准打法：不正面否定结论，而是拆掉对方的隐含前提。rest on＝建立在……之上。

notes.mark: History suggests otherwise.
notes.note: 三个词的短句，夹在两个长句之间。长短交错是英文节奏感的来源，中国学生的作文往往全是等长句。

notes.mark: were nowhere on any syllabus a generation ago
notes.note: 用具体的时间对照（一代人之前）把抽象论断落地，比写 in the past 有力得多。

notes.mark: answer to no immediate employer
notes.note: answer to sb.＝对某人负责。这个说法比 not related to jobs 优雅，也更准确地表达了“学术自由”的含义。

paragraphs.analysis: 这段的价值在于换了角度：不谈情怀，谈“未来不可预测”。凡是能把价值论证转成风险论证的，说服力都会上一个台阶。

paragraphs.text: The opposition, in my view, is largely false. The most employable graduates I have encountered are not those who memorised the software of the moment, but those who learned how to learn and could therefore pick up the next tool in a fortnight. A sensible university therefore does both: it teaches transferable habits of mind through demanding academic work, and it attaches to that core a thin, deliberately updatable layer of professional training—internships, industry projects, technical certification.

notes.mark: The opposition, in my view, is largely false.
notes.note: 整合型立场的关键句。加 largely 而非 completely，保留分寸，符合学术写作的审慎语气。

notes.mark: not those who memorised the software of the moment, but those who learned how to learn
notes.note: not A but B 平行结构，形式对称让对比一目了然。the software of the moment（当下流行的软件）用词讥诮而不失体面。

notes.mark: a thin, deliberately updatable layer
notes.note: 形容词选得极准：thin（薄）+ updatable（可更新），把“职业培训应当轻量且随时可换”这层意思压进了三个词里。

notes.mark: internships, industry projects, technical certification
notes.note: 破折号后三项并列收尾，给抽象方案一个具体着陆点。这是把 7 分作文推到 7.5 的细节。

paragraphs.analysis: 很多考生在这一段和稀泥（both are important），失分点就在没给出“怎么结合”。这里给了明确的结构：厚的通识内核 + 薄的可替换外层。

paragraphs.text: The question, then, is not whether universities should serve the economy or the intellect, but in what proportion and in what order. Get the sequence right—rigorous thinking first, marketable technique second—and the two purposes cease to compete.

notes.mark: The question, then, is not whether
notes.note: 呼应开头的张力，把二选一改写成“配比与次序”问题。这是结尾升华最稳的一种写法。

notes.mark: Get the sequence right
notes.note: 祈使句开头 + 破折号插入，节奏明快，避免了结尾段常见的疲软。

notes.mark: cease to compete
notes.note: cease to do 比 stop doing 正式。收尾干净利落，不再堆砌新信息。

paragraphs.analysis: 两句话结尾，不复述全文。好的结尾是给出一个新的看问题的角度，而不是把前面的话再说一遍。

highlights.en: rests on a shaky assumption
highlights.zh: 建立在一个站不住脚的前提上
highlights.why: 驳论万能句，攻击前提而非结论。

highlights.en: a measurable return on that investment
highlights.zh: 可衡量的投资回报
highlights.why: 教育、医疗、公共政策类话题通用。

highlights.en: the trained capacity to read closely, weigh evidence and reason under uncertainty
highlights.zh: 细读文本、权衡证据、在不确定中推理的受训能力
highlights.why: 三项并列定义“素养”，可直接迁移到任何教育类题目。

highlights.en: answer to no immediate employer
highlights.zh: 不必对任何直接雇主负责
highlights.why: 描述基础研究、纯艺术、人文学科的价值时好用。

highlights.en: not whether ... but in what proportion and in what order
highlights.zh: 不在于是否……，而在于以何种比例、何种次序
highlights.why: 结尾升华模板，适用于一切“两难取舍”题。

takeaway: 这篇的核心技巧只有一个：把“二选一”重构成“包含关系或配比关系”。凡是 Discuss both views 的题，谁能证明双方的对立是假的，谁的立意就最高。

title: 图表描述：某国四种能源发电占比的变化
genre: 图表作文 · 趋势描述
prompt: The chart below shows the percentage of electricity generated from four sources in one country between 2000 and 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features.

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 改写题目
outline.purpose: 换词改写，绝不照抄原题

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 总体概述
outline.purpose: 两句话点出最大趋势和格局反转——这是评分的关键项

outline.label: 第 3–4 段 · 分组细节
outline.purpose: 上升的一组、下降的一组，分开写，配具体数据

paragraphs.text: The chart illustrates how four sources contributed to national electricity generation over a twenty-four-year period from 2000 to 2024.

notes.mark: illustrates how four sources contributed to
notes.note: shows→illustrates，the percentage of electricity generated from→how sources contributed to。改写要换结构，不能只换同义词。

notes.mark: over a twenty-four-year period
notes.note: 把 between 2000 and 2024 换算成时间跨度，是最省力的改写手法。

paragraphs.analysis: 一句话足够。Task 1 的开头段写长了是浪费字数。

paragraphs.text: Overall, the period saw a decisive shift away from coal towards renewables, with the two exchanging positions around 2016. Nuclear power, by contrast, remained broadly stable throughout, while natural gas rose sharply before tapering off in the final years.

notes.mark: Overall,
notes.note: 概述段必须有 Overall 或 In general 领起——没有独立的概述段，分数很难上 6。

notes.mark: a decisive shift away from coal towards renewables
notes.note: 一句话概括全局趋势。shift away from A towards B 是趋势类图表的万能骨架。

notes.mark: with the two exchanging positions around 2016
notes.note: with 独立结构补充交叉点。识别并写出“反超时刻”是拉分点。

notes.mark: remained broadly stable
notes.note: broadly 是模糊限定词，比写 remained stable 更贴合真实数据的小幅波动。

notes.mark: before tapering off
notes.note: taper off＝逐渐减弱。比 then decreased 精确，描述“先升后缓降”极好用。

paragraphs.analysis: 概述段不写任何具体数字，只写趋势和格局——这是 Task 1 最容易被忽略的规则。

paragraphs.text: Renewables accounted for a mere 6% of output in 2000 but climbed steadily thereafter, overtaking gas in 2016 and reaching 41% by 2024—a nearly sevenfold increase. Gas followed a less dramatic path, rising from 18% to a peak of 33% in 2018 before settling at around 28%.

notes.mark: accounted for a mere 6%
notes.note: account for＝占比，Task 1 核心搭配。a mere 6% 里的 mere 带出“少得可怜”的评价，比干巴巴的 only 生动。

notes.mark: climbed steadily thereafter
notes.note: 动词 + 副词的搭配（幅度＋速度）是选词的核心。climbed steadily／rose sharply／edged up 要分清。

notes.mark: a nearly sevenfold increase
notes.note: 倍数表达：sevenfold 作形容词，不要写成 seven times increase。这类表达在考场上极为亮眼。

notes.mark: before settling at around 28%
notes.note: settle at＝稳定在某水平。三个动词 rising / peak / settling 串起一条完整曲线。

paragraphs.analysis: 每个数据点都绑定了年份，且用破折号补充倍数关系。数据不是罗列，而是服务于趋势描述。

paragraphs.role: 细节 · 下降与持平组
paragraphs.text: Coal moved in precisely the opposite direction, shrinking from a dominant 52% to just 15%. Nuclear, meanwhile, was the only source to show no meaningful change, hovering between 15% and 18% across the entire period.

notes.mark: moved in precisely the opposite direction
notes.note: 对比衔接句，避免了机械的 On the other hand。

notes.mark: shrinking from a dominant 52% to just 15%
notes.note: dominant 一词点出 2000 年煤炭的统治地位，用形容词承载评价而不额外加句子。

notes.mark: hovering between 15% and 18%
notes.note: hover between＝在区间内小幅波动，是描述“基本持平”的最佳动词。

paragraphs.analysis: 把下降组和持平组合并成一段，结构更紧凑。Task 1 的段落划分应按“数据行为”分组，而不是按数据条数分。

highlights.en: a decisive shift away from A towards B
highlights.zh: 从 A 向 B 的决定性转变
highlights.why: 趋势类图表的概述句骨架。

highlights.en: account for / make up X% of
highlights.zh: 占 X%
highlights.why: 占比表达的第一选择，不要用 occupy。

highlights.en: climb steadily / rise sharply / edge up / taper off / hover between
highlights.zh: 稳步攀升／急剧上升／微升／逐渐减弱／小幅波动
highlights.why: 五个动词覆盖绝大多数曲线形态。

highlights.en: a nearly sevenfold increase
highlights.zh: 近七倍的增长
highlights.why: 倍数表达，注意 -fold 是形容词。

takeaway: Task 1 拿分的顺序是：独立概述段 ＞ 数据准确 ＞ 词汇花哨。先保证有 Overall 段并写对整体格局，再考虑用词升级。

title: 辞职信：向老板说明离职决定
prompt: Two months ago you got a job as an editor for the magazine Designs & Fashions. But now you find that the work is not what you expected. You decide to quit. Write a letter to your boss, Mr. Wang, telling him your decision, stating your reason(s), and making an apology. Write your letter with no less than 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter; use “Li Ming” instead.

outline.label: 称呼
outline.purpose: 写给具体的人就写具体姓名，Dear Mr. Wang 比 Dear Sir 得体

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 表明决定
outline.purpose: 开门见山说辞职，一句话讲完，不铺垫不寒暄

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 陈述理由
outline.purpose: 把矛盾定位在「岗位职责与个人能力不匹配」，不抱怨人也不抱怨公司

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 致歉与补救
outline.purpose: 为造成的不便道歉，并主动提出交接，留下职业体面

outline.label: 落款
outline.purpose: Yours sincerely + Li Ming，正式信件的固定收尾

paragraphs.text: Dear Mr. Wang,
I am writing to formally inform you of my decision to resign from my current position as an editor for the magazine Designs & Fashions.

notes.mark: I am writing to formally inform you of
notes.note: 应用文第一句永远是「我为什么写这封信」。formally 一词先把全信的语域定成正式函件，后面就不能再出现口语化表达。

notes.mark: my decision to resign
notes.note: 把「辞职」放在名词短语里而不是写成 I want to quit，语气从情绪宣泄变成已经作出的理性决定，不留讨价还价的余地。

notes.mark: my current position as an editor for the magazine Designs & Fashions
notes.note: 写清职位和单位，是为了让这封信本身可以进人事档案。应用文要经得起「脱离上下文单独阅读」。

paragraphs.analysis: 一句话完成一个段落。小作文最容易失分的地方是第一段写三四句还没说到正事——阅卷人找不到「决定」这个采分点。

paragraphs.text: The primary reason for my departure is that I find the daily responsibilities of this job are quite different from what I had expected when I was hired. I originally hoped to be involved more in the creative side of design and content generation. However, my current duties are predominantly clerical and administrative. Therefore, I feel that my skills and academic background would be better utilized in a position that focuses heavily on original design work.

notes.mark: The primary reason for my departure is that
notes.note: 主语从「我」切成「原因」。如果写 I don't like this job，矛盾就是个人好恶；写成客观原因，矛盾变成事实陈述，对方无从反驳也不会觉得被冒犯。

notes.mark: predominantly clerical and administrative
notes.note: 用 predominantly（主要是）而不是 entirely（完全是）。留一线余地既显得严谨，也避免把话说死得罪原单位。这个副词的分寸感就是小作文的分数。

notes.mark: my skills and academic background would be better utilized
notes.note: 全信最关键的一句：主语是「我的能力」，被动语态 be utilized。说的是「我的能力放在别处更合适」，而不是「你们的工作太差」。矛盾被彻底转移到匹配度问题上。

notes.mark: would be
notes.note: 虚拟语气的 would 让判断带上「设想」的色彩，比 will 柔和。正式信件里凡是涉及评价的地方，优先用 would。

paragraphs.analysis: 四句话的主语依次是：原因 → 我 → 我的职责 → 我的能力。只有中间一句用第一人称说个人期望，其余全部用客观事物作主语。这就是「说理由要客观化」的具体操作方式。

paragraphs.text: I sincerely apologize for any inconvenience my sudden departure may cause to the editorial team. I will do my best to assist with the handover of my duties before I leave. Thank you for the opportunity and your understanding.

notes.mark: I sincerely apologize for any inconvenience
notes.note: 道歉必须回到第一人称。前面理由段刻意躲开「我」，这里必须主动认领责任，一躲一认，态度才立体。

notes.mark: my sudden departure
notes.note: 用 sudden 自己点破「突然」，等于承认对方的难处。自己先说出来，比等对方来指出要体面得多。

notes.mark: I will do my best to assist with the handover of my duties
notes.note: 道歉之后必须给方案。只说抱歉不给补救，在阅卷标准里属于要点不全。handover（交接）是职场语境的准确用词。

paragraphs.analysis: 三句话对应三个动作：道歉、补救、致谢。注意最后一句同时感谢「机会」和「理解」——前者指过去，后者指眼下这封信，收得干净。

paragraphs.text:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

highlights.en: I am writing to formally inform you of my decision to ...
highlights.zh: 我写信是为了正式告知您我……的决定
highlights.why: 一切正式通知类信件的起手式，把 inform 换成 express / request 即可平移。

highlights.en: The primary reason for ... is that ...
highlights.zh: ……的主要原因在于
highlights.why: 陈述理由时把主语客观化的万能骨架，避免通篇 I think。

highlights.en: my skills would be better utilized in a position that ...
highlights.zh: 我的能力在……的岗位上能得到更好的发挥
highlights.why: 辞职、转岗、求职信通用的「不贬低对方」句式。

highlights.en: I sincerely apologize for any inconvenience ... may cause
highlights.zh: 对……可能造成的不便，我诚挚致歉
highlights.why: 道歉句模板，may cause 用情态动词弱化，不把责任说得过重。

highlights.en: assist with the handover of my duties
highlights.zh: 协助完成工作交接
highlights.why: 提出补救方案的具体动作，比 help you 精确得多。

takeaway: 辞职信的分寸感全在主语上：说决定用 I，说理由切到「原因／职责／能力」这类客观主语，说歉意再切回 I。躲开一次、认领一次，态度才显得既坚决又得体。

title: 养老足球赛：儿女互相推诿赡养责任
genre: 漫画作文 · 现象批判
prompt:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should describe the drawing briefly, explain its intended meaning, and then give your comments.

【漫画】标题为「养老足球赛」。画面正中，一位老父亲缩成一团被当成足球；球场四角分别守着他的几个子女，把老父亲踢来踢去，互相推诿。

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 描述画面
outline.purpose: 由全景到核心人物到配角再到字幕，四步走完，最后点出字幕与画面的反讽

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 揭示寓意
outline.purpose: 点明社会现象，并交代「经济上升而道德下滑」这一背景反差

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 提出对策
outline.purpose: 道德教育 + 法律惩戒两条腿，收在对老年人生活的愿景上

paragraphs.text: As is vividly depicted in the drawing, a heartbreaking “football match” is taking place on a field. An elderly man is curled up like a football in the middle, while his three sons and one daughter stand at the four corners, acting as “goalkeepers.” Instead of taking care of their old father, they are kicking him back and forth, desperately trying to avoid their responsibility. The caption reads “Supporting the Elderly,” which creates a striking and ironic contrast with the cruel scene.

notes.mark: As is vividly depicted in the drawing
notes.note: 漫画作文的固定开场。As 引导的非限制性定语从句 + 被动语态，主语藏起来，描述显得客观。depicted 可替换成 portrayed / illustrated / shown，一年一换避免雷同。

notes.mark: heartbreaking
notes.note: 第一个形容词就定基调。描述段不是纯客观复述，一个带情绪的形容词提前告诉阅卷人「我看懂了这是悲剧」。

notes.mark: curled up like a football
notes.note: 描述画面要抓住那个最反常的细节。curled up（蜷缩）把「人被当成球」这一荒诞感一句话说尽。

notes.mark: Instead of taking care of their old father
notes.note: 用 Instead of 制造「应然」与「实然」的落差——本该赡养，实际在踢。描述里嵌入评判，比平铺直叙有力。

notes.mark: desperately
notes.note: 刻画推诿时的丑态。desperately（拼命地）修饰 trying to avoid，把逃避写成了一种用力的、主动的行为。

notes.mark: which creates a striking and ironic contrast
notes.note: 描述段的收尾必须点出字幕与画面的反差，这是漫画类作文的固定采分点。striking and ironic 两个形容词并列，一个说视觉冲击，一个说修辞性质。

paragraphs.analysis: 镜头顺序：全景（球赛）→ 核心（父亲）→ 配角（子女）→ 字幕。四步之内交代完，且每一步都带一个评价性形容词。描述段最忌讳只写 There is a man and four children.

paragraphs.text: The intended meaning of the picture is to reveal a disturbing social phenomenon: a fraction of adult children refuse to fulfill their moral and legal obligations to support their aging parents. With the rapid development of the economy, people’s living standards have improved significantly. However, some young people have become increasingly selfish and indifferent. They regard their old and frail parents as a heavy burden rather than the ones who raised them with endless love, patience, and sacrifice.

notes.mark: The intended meaning of the picture is to reveal
notes.note: 第二段的第一句必须是点题句，主语用「画面的寓意」这个抽象概念，从描述层正式切换到论理层。

notes.mark: a disturbing social phenomenon
notes.note: 给现象定性的关键形容词。disturbing（令人不安的）比 bad 精确，且自带评价立场。

notes.mark: moral and legal obligations
notes.note: 赡养话题的核心搭配：既是道德义务也是法律义务。这两个词一出，第三段的「教育 + 法律」两条对策就有了伏笔。

notes.mark: With the rapid development of the economy
notes.note: 交代背景。批判类文章不能只骂人，要给出现象为什么会在这个时代出现——经济上升与道德下滑的反差本身就是论点。

notes.mark: selfish and indifferent
notes.note: 精准定性被批判群体。两个形容词分工：selfish 说动机，indifferent 说态度。

notes.mark: rather than the ones who raised them with endless love, patience, and sacrifice
notes.note: 全段情感最重的一句。用三个抽象名词并列（love, patience, sacrifice）与前面的 a heavy burden 形成道德反差，不用一个「应该」就完成了谴责。

paragraphs.analysis: 论理段的主语依次是：寓意 → 生活水平 → 部分年轻人 → 他们。从抽象概念落到具体群体，批判对象越来越明确，这是批判类文章的标准推进方式。

paragraphs.text: In my view, it is imperative that we take effective measures to reverse this deeply disappointing trend. On the one hand, traditional moral education emphasizing filial piety should be enhanced among the younger generation. On the other hand, relevant laws must be strictly enforced to penalize those who abandon their elderly parents. Only in this way can we ensure that all senior citizens enjoy a happy and secure later life.

notes.mark: it is imperative that we take effective measures
notes.note: 形式主语 it + imperative，表达不容置疑的紧迫感。注意 imperative 后的从句用虚拟语气（take 而非 takes）。

notes.mark: traditional moral education emphasizing filial piety should be enhanced
notes.note: 对策段的主语是「措施」本身，配被动语态。不写谁来做，强调动作本身，语气更像政策建议而非个人喊话。

notes.mark: relevant laws must be strictly enforced
notes.note: must 比 should 重一档，用在法律这一条上，与前一条教育的 should 形成力度区分。修饰语的轻重要跟着措施的性质走。

notes.mark: Only in this way can we ensure
notes.note: Only 置于句首引起部分倒装（can we），是结尾升华的高频句式。倒装本身就是一个语法采分点。

paragraphs.analysis: 两条对策一软一硬：教育用 should，法律用 must。结尾不停在「措施」上，而是落到「老年人过上安稳晚年」这个愿景，把文章从批判拉回建设性。

highlights.en: As is vividly depicted in the drawing, ...
highlights.zh: 如画中生动描绘的那样
highlights.why: 漫画作文第一句，被动语态保证描述的客观性。

highlights.en: creates a striking and ironic contrast with
highlights.zh: 与……形成鲜明而讽刺的反差
highlights.why: 点出字幕与画面反差的固定表达，漫画题必用。

highlights.en: refuse to fulfill their moral and legal obligations
highlights.zh: 拒绝履行道德与法律义务
highlights.why: 责任缺失类话题的核心定性短语。

highlights.en: it is imperative that we take effective measures to ...
highlights.zh: 我们必须采取有效措施来……
highlights.why: 对策段起手式，注意从句用虚拟语气。

highlights.en: Only in this way can we ensure that ...
highlights.zh: 只有这样我们才能确保……
highlights.why: 结尾倒装句，语法采分点，几乎所有对策类文章都能用。

takeaway: 漫画作文的三段各有一个不可省的动作：第一段要点出「字幕与画面的反差」，第二段要给现象定性并交代时代背景，第三段的对策要一软一硬并落到愿景。缺任何一个都会被判为要点不全。

title: 请求信：为希望工程寻找资助对象
prompt: You want to contribute to Project Hope by offering financial aid to a child in a remote area. Write a letter to the department concerned, asking them to help find a candidate, specifying what kind of child you want to help and how you will carry out your plan. Write your letter with no less than 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter; use “Li Ming” instead.

outline.label: 称呼
outline.purpose: 写给机构而非具体个人，用 Dear Sir or Madam

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 说明来意
outline.purpose: 表达资助意愿 + 提出请求，两个要点一段说完

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 两个具体要求
outline.purpose: 先说资助什么样的孩子，再说怎么执行，对应题目的第 2、3 条

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 致谢与期待
outline.purpose: 感谢 + 期待回复，请求信的固定收尾

outline.label: 落款
outline.purpose: Yours sincerely + Li Ming

paragraphs.text: Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to express my earnest desire to contribute to Project Hope by offering financial assistance to a child in a poverty-stricken area. I would be deeply grateful if your department could help me identify a suitable candidate.

notes.mark: my earnest desire to contribute
notes.note: 请求信开头要先说「我想做什么」再说「请你帮什么」。earnest（诚挚的）把动机说成主动意愿，而不是一时兴起。

notes.mark: a poverty-stricken area
notes.note: 题目原词是 remote area（偏远地区），范文换成 poverty-stricken（贫困的）。改写题目而不是照抄，是应用文和大作文共同的加分点；而且贫困比偏远更贴合希望工程的语境。

notes.mark: I would be deeply grateful if your department could help me
notes.note: 提请求的标准柔化结构：would be grateful if + could。两层虚拟语气叠加，把命令句变成恳请句，写给机构时尤其必要。

paragraphs.analysis: 两句话分别对应「意愿」和「请求」。注意请求那一句的主语是 I，但真正的动作发出者是 your department——用 if 从句把对方的动作包进来，比 Please find a child for me 得体得多。

paragraphs.text: Specifically, I would like to sponsor a primary school girl who comes from a disadvantaged family background but demonstrates an excellent academic record. As for the implementation of my plan, I intend to remit a fixed amount of money directly to her school account at the beginning of each semester. This funding is intended to cover her tuition fees and basic living expenses until she completes her primary education.

notes.mark: Specifically
notes.note: 一个词就完成从「泛说」到「细说」的过渡。应用文段落之间不需要 Firstly / Secondly 这种笨重的连接词，Specifically、As for 这类更自然。

notes.mark: who comes from a disadvantaged family background but demonstrates an excellent academic record
notes.note: 定语从句里用 but 制造转折：家境差但成绩好。两个条件一句话说完，比分成两句紧凑，也说明了「为什么值得资助」。

notes.mark: As for the implementation of my plan
notes.note: 明确切到题目的第三个要点。阅卷人是按要点找分的，这种显性路标能保证不漏判。

notes.mark: remit a fixed amount of money directly to her school account
notes.note: 执行方案要具体到可操作：汇多少（fixed amount）、汇给谁（school account）、怎么汇（directly）。三个限定词一个都不能少，否则就是空话。

notes.mark: This funding is intended to cover
notes.note: 主语从「我」切换成「这笔钱」。谈财务细节时用事物作主语，显得有规划性，也避免连续三句都以 I 开头。

paragraphs.analysis: 这一段同时完成题目的两个要点，靠的是 Specifically 和 As for 两个路标。最后一句把主语交给「资金」，是全信唯一一次主语跳出第一人称，正好落在最需要客观感的财务安排上。

paragraphs.text: Thank you for your time and kind assistance. I look forward to your favorable reply.

notes.mark: your time and kind assistance
notes.note: 感谢要分两项：占用的时间、提供的帮助。写给机构时这样更礼貌。

notes.mark: your favorable reply
notes.note: favorable（肯定的）比单纯的 reply 多一层期待，是请求信的固定收尾。不要写成 I hope you will agree，太直白。

paragraphs.text:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

highlights.en: I am writing to express my earnest desire to ...
highlights.zh: 我写信是为了表达我……的殷切愿望
highlights.why: 请求信、申请信开头，比 I want to 正式一档。

highlights.en: I would be deeply grateful if you could ...
highlights.zh: 如果您能……，我将不胜感激
highlights.why: 提请求的万能柔化句式，两层虚拟语气。

highlights.en: As for the implementation of my plan, ...
highlights.zh: 至于我这个计划的执行
highlights.why: 切换到「怎么做」这一要点的路标，保证要点不漏判。

highlights.en: a disadvantaged family background but an excellent academic record
highlights.zh: 家境困难但成绩优异
highlights.why: 资助、奖学金、推荐类话题描述人选的标准搭配。

highlights.en: I look forward to your favorable reply.
highlights.zh: 期待您的肯定答复。
highlights.why: 请求信结尾定式。

takeaway: 请求信写的是「我想做什么 + 请你配合什么」。凡是需要对方付出的动作，一律包进 if 从句并配虚拟语气；凡是自己承诺的动作，就用 I 或事物作主语写得斩钉截铁。

title: 偶像崇拜：把贝克汉姆写在脸上
genre: 漫画作文 · 辩证分析
prompt:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should describe the drawing briefly, explain its intended meaning, and then give your comments.

【漫画】标题为「偶像崇拜」。画中是一个年轻人的面部特写，他的发型模仿足球明星贝克汉姆，脸颊上赫然写着「贝克汉姆」四个大字。

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 描述画面
outline.purpose: 脸上的字 → 发型 → 字幕，三个细节按显眼程度排序

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 辩证分析
outline.purpose: 先承认崇拜偶像可以理解，再批判盲目模仿的危害——现象类题目不能一边倒

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 给出立场
outline.purpose: 不是反对崇拜，而是把崇拜的对象从外表换成品质

paragraphs.text: As is vividly portrayed in the drawing, a young man has the Chinese characters for “Beckham”, a globally renowned football superstar, written prominently across his face. Additionally, he is sporting exactly the same hairstyle as his idol. The caption below, “Idol Worship,” explicitly highlights the central theme of this cartoon.

notes.mark: As is vividly portrayed in the drawing
notes.note: 与 2005 年的 depicted 换一个词。同一套句式换动词，既是词汇量的体现，也避免全篇模板感。

notes.mark: a globally renowned football superstar
notes.note: 同位语补充说明贝克汉姆是谁。阅卷人未必都熟悉这个名字，一个同位语解决背景问题，同时贡献了一组高级搭配。

notes.mark: written prominently across his face
notes.note: prominently（醒目地）+ across（横跨）两个词把「写满整张脸」的荒诞感写出来了。描述画面靠的是这种精确的介词和副词，不是华丽的形容词。

notes.mark: exactly the same hairstyle
notes.note: exactly 强调「一模一样」，暗示模仿的机械与彻底，为第二段批判 superficial imitation 埋下伏笔。

notes.mark: explicitly highlights the central theme
notes.note: 与 2005 年的「反讽反差」不同：这幅画的字幕是直接点题的，所以用 explicitly（直白地）而不是 ironically。描述要贴合画面本身的修辞方式。

paragraphs.analysis: 三个细节的排列顺序是按视觉冲击力：先写脸上的字（最刺眼），再写发型（次之），最后写字幕（文字信息）。描述段的顺序本身就是一种取舍判断。

paragraphs.text: The picture aims to draw our attention to a widespread social phenomenon: the blind worship of celebrities among youth. On the one hand, it is understandable that young people admire successful figures, whose achievements can serve as an inspiration. On the other hand, the problem arises when this admiration turns into superficial and irrational imitation. Many teenagers waste a considerable amount of time and money copying their idols’ appearances, clothing, or lifestyles. This blind worship not only distracts them from their academic pursuits but also hinders the development of their independent thinking.

notes.mark: it is understandable that young people admire successful figures
notes.note: 这一句是 2006 年和 2005 年的分水岭。养老题可以一边倒地批判，追星题不行——先给对方合理性，后面的批判才不显得偏激。understandable 是让步的关键词。

notes.mark: the problem arises when
notes.note: 转折的支点。不说「崇拜是错的」，而说「崇拜在越过某条线之后才成为问题」。把批判的对象从「行为」缩小到「行为的过度形态」，立意立刻稳当。

notes.mark: superficial and irrational imitation
notes.note: 精准定性负面行为：superficial 说层次浅，irrational 说不理性。两个形容词分别对应第三段的两个对策方向。

notes.mark: not only distracts them from their academic pursuits but also hinders the development of their independent thinking
notes.note: 危害要写两层：一层是眼前的（耽误学业），一层是长远的（妨碍独立思考）。not only ... but also 让递进关系显性化。

paragraphs.analysis: 整段是一个完整的辩证结构：点题 → On the one hand 让步 → On the other hand 批判 → 具体表现 → 深层危害。主语从抽象概念（The picture / the problem）落到具体群体（Many teenagers），再升回抽象（This blind worship）。

paragraphs.text: In my opinion, it is essential that we guide young people to adopt a rational attitude towards idol worship. Rather than merely mimicking celebrities’ outward appearances, we should encourage the youth to learn from their underlying virtues, such as perseverance, dedication, and the courage to overcome adversities.

notes.mark: guide young people to adopt a rational attitude
notes.note: 对策是「引导」而不是「禁止」，呼应第二段给过的让步。全文立场因此是一致的，不会前后打架。

notes.mark: Rather than merely mimicking celebrities’ outward appearances
notes.note: 用 Rather than 把「错的做法」和「对的做法」并排放在一句话里，对比最省字数。

notes.mark: outward appearances
notes.note: 与后面的 underlying virtues 构成一组工整的形容词对立：外在的 vs 内在的。这一对反义修饰语是这篇文章思想深度的落点。

notes.mark: perseverance, dedication, and the courage to overcome adversities
notes.note: 三项并列具体化「品质」。抽象词后面必须跟具体清单，否则读者不知道你在说什么。

paragraphs.analysis: 只有两句话，但完成了立场的正反两面：不要模仿什么、应该学习什么。结尾不喊口号，落在三个具体的品质名词上。

highlights.en: The picture aims to draw our attention to a widespread social phenomenon: ...
highlights.zh: 这幅画意在提醒我们注意一个普遍的社会现象：
highlights.why: 第二段点题句，冒号后直接给出现象，干净利落。

highlights.en: it is understandable that ..., but the problem arises when ...
highlights.zh: ……是可以理解的，但当……时问题就出现了
highlights.why: 辩证类题目的核心骨架，先让步再限定批判范围。

highlights.en: superficial and irrational imitation
highlights.zh: 肤浅且非理性的模仿
highlights.why: 追星、跟风、消费主义类话题的定性短语。

highlights.en: Rather than merely mimicking ... , we should learn from ...
highlights.zh: 与其仅仅模仿……，我们更应学习……
highlights.why: 把错误做法与正确做法并排对比，一句话完成立场。

highlights.en: outward appearances / underlying virtues
highlights.zh: 外在形象／内在品质
highlights.why: 一组现成的反义修饰语，任何「表象 vs 本质」的话题都能用。

takeaway: 凡是「现象类」而非「问题类」的题目（追星、网购、直播、AI），第二段绝不能一边倒。先用 it is understandable that 承认它的合理性，再用 the problem arises when 划出批判的边界——立意的高低就差在这一步。

title: 建议信：改进大学图书馆的服务
prompt: Write a letter to your university library, making suggestions for improving its service. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead.

outline.label: 称呼
outline.purpose: 写给部门，用 Dear Sir or Madam

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 先扬后提
outline.purpose: 先肯定对方的工作，再引出建议——建设性批评的前提

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 三条建议
outline.purpose: 延长开放时间、升级检索系统、增订期刊；每条都是「现状 + 建议」

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 表达期待
outline.purpose: 希望被采纳 + 再次致谢

outline.label: 落款
outline.purpose: Yours sincerely + Li Ming

paragraphs.text: Dear Sir or Madam,
As a frequent visitor to the university library, I am writing to express my appreciation for your hard work, and to offer a few suggestions to further improve your services.

notes.mark: As a frequent visitor to the university library
notes.note: 先交代身份。说明「我常来，所以我的意见有代表性」，一句话给建议赋予了可信度。建议信开头几乎都需要这样一个身份状语。

notes.mark: express my appreciation for your hard work
notes.note: 先扬后抑。不铺这一句直接提意见，容易读成投诉信。这是建议信与投诉信最重要的区别。

notes.mark: further improve
notes.note: further（进一步）暗含「现在已经不错」的前提。一个副词就把「你们有问题」改成了「可以更好」。

paragraphs.analysis: 一句话套三个动作：亮明身份、表达肯定、引出建议。and 连接两个不定式（to express... and to offer...），结构紧凑。

paragraphs.text: First and foremost, I suggest extending the opening hours, particularly during the final exam weeks. Currently, the library closes at 9:00 PM, which is quite inconvenient for students who need to study late. Secondly, the digital catalog system frequently crashes or responds slowly. It would be highly beneficial if the system could be upgraded to ensure smoother book searches. Finally, it would be wonderful if more up-to-date academic journals could be subscribed to in the reading room.

notes.mark: the library closes at 9:00 PM
notes.note: 指出问题时主语是「图书馆」这个机构或系统，不是「你们」。绝不写 You close the library too early——对事不对人是建议信的铁律。

notes.mark: the digital catalog system frequently crashes
notes.note: 同理，让「系统」自己作主语去承担问题。frequently 客观陈述频率，不带情绪。

notes.mark: It would be highly beneficial if the system could be upgraded
notes.note: 形式主语 It + would + if 从句 + 被动。三重柔化，把「你们该升级系统」说成「系统若能升级会很有益」。建议信最核心的句型。

notes.mark: it would be wonderful if
notes.note: 与上一条的 It would be highly beneficial 换个说法，避免两条建议句式雷同。同一个功能准备两三种表达，是小作文避免模板腔的关键。

notes.mark: quite inconvenient
notes.note: 程度副词的分寸：quite（相当）而非 extremely（极其）。抱怨过重会破坏前面铺好的友好气氛。

paragraphs.analysis: 三条建议的写法是「现状 + 建议」交替：第一条先建议后说现状，第二条先说现状后建议，第三条只给建议。句式轮换，读起来不像清单。

paragraphs.text: I hope you will take my suggestions into consideration. Thank you for your continued efforts to provide a better learning environment.

notes.mark: take my suggestions into consideration
notes.note: 「加以考虑」而不是「予以采纳」。把决定权留给对方，是建议信的收尾礼节。

notes.mark: your continued efforts
notes.note: 结尾再肯定一次，与第一段的 appreciation 首尾呼应。continued（持续的）暗示「你们一直在努力」。

paragraphs.text:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

highlights.en: As a frequent visitor to ... , I am writing to ...
highlights.zh: 作为……的常客，我写信……
highlights.why: 建议信开头的身份状语，一句话建立发言资格。

highlights.en: It would be highly beneficial if ... could be upgraded
highlights.zh: 如果……能够升级，将大有裨益
highlights.why: 建议信第一句型：形式主语 + 虚拟语气 + 被动，三重柔化。

highlights.en: I suggest extending the opening hours
highlights.zh: 我建议延长开放时间
highlights.why: 注意 suggest 后接动名词，不接 to do，这是高频语法失分点。

highlights.en: take my suggestions into consideration
highlights.zh: 考虑我的建议
highlights.why: 结尾定式，把决定权交还对方。

highlights.en: up-to-date academic journals
highlights.zh: 最新的学术期刊
highlights.why: 校园设施类话题的现成搭配。

takeaway: 建议信全靠「主语躲人」和「句式柔化」两招：指出问题时让机构或系统自己作主语，提出建议时套 It would be ... if ... could be ... 的壳。抱怨的程度副词一律取中档，不用最高级。

title: 点球大战：自信如何扭曲我们眼中的世界
genre: 漫画作文 · 哲理评论
prompt:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should describe the drawing briefly, explain its intended meaning, and then give your comments.

【漫画】一个正在扑救点球的守门员。在他的想象中，自己渺小如鼠、对方球员无比巨大；而在对方球员的想象中，守门员大如巨人几乎堵住整个球门，自己却非常渺小。图下文字：点球大战（缺少自信）。

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 描述画面
outline.purpose: 先写场景，再写两个人脑海中互为镜像的想象，最后点字幕

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 揭示哲理
outline.purpose: 从画面提炼出「自信不足会扭曲认知、放大困难」这一命题

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 给出方法
outline.purpose: 准确评估自己 + 坚信潜力，以名言收尾

paragraphs.text: As is vividly depicted in the cartoon, a tense penalty shootout is taking place on a football field. However, what makes the picture thought-provoking is the sharp contrast in the minds of the two players. In the goalkeeper’s imagination, he shrinks to the size of a mouse, while the striker appears as a towering giant. Ironically, in the striker’s mind, the situation is completely reversed: the goalkeeper looks gigantic enough to block the entire goal. The caption reads, “Penalty Shootout: Lack of Confidence.”

notes.mark: what makes the picture thought-provoking is
notes.note: 名词性从句作主语。这幅画的看点不在场景而在两人的心理，用主语从句把「值得琢磨的地方」直接顶到句首，等于替阅卷人划了重点。

notes.mark: the sharp contrast in the minds of the two players
notes.note: 先给出「对比」这个总纲，再分述两边。描述复杂画面时，先总后分能省掉大量连接词。

notes.mark: he shrinks to the size of a mouse
notes.note: shrink（缩小）配 the size of a mouse，用具体的量度写抽象的心理。写心理活动要落到可视的比喻上。

notes.mark: a towering giant
notes.note: towering（高耸的）与前面的 mouse 形成极端反差。这一对意象是全画的核心，必须译足力度。

notes.mark: Ironically
notes.note: 一个副词完成转折。两人的想象互为镜像，这个「反讽」正是漫画的机锋所在，不点破就等于没看懂。

notes.mark: the situation is completely reversed
notes.note: 不重复描述第二个人的想象细节，用「完全反过来」一笔带过。描述段字数宝贵，重复的结构要压缩。

paragraphs.analysis: 这幅画比 2005、2006 都难描述，因为有两层心理空间。范文的处理是：先总（sharp contrast）→ 分述甲 → Ironically 转 → 分述乙（压缩）→ 点字幕。层次感靠的是先总后分，不是堆细节。

paragraphs.text: The intended meaning of this drawing is profoundly clear: a lack of self-confidence can distort our perception of reality and magnify the difficulties we face. In our daily lives and academic pursuits, it is common to encounter formidable challenges. If we underestimate our own abilities and overestimate the obstacles, much like the players in the picture, we are bound to feel intimidated and anxious. This psychological barrier often leads to failure before the actual battle even begins.

notes.mark: a lack of self-confidence can distort our perception of reality and magnify the difficulties
notes.note: 把画面翻译成命题的关键一句。两个动词 distort（扭曲）和 magnify（放大）精确对应画面里「变形」和「变大」的视觉效果——寓意句必须从画面里长出来，不能凭空拔高。

notes.mark: underestimate our own abilities and overestimate the obstacles
notes.note: under- 和 over- 一对前缀构成工整对仗，正好复刻画面里一小一大的镜像结构。构词法在这里直接变成了修辞。

notes.mark: much like the players in the picture
notes.note: 论理中途回扣画面一次。哲理类文章最容易写飘，一句插入语就把抽象论述重新钉回图上。

notes.mark: we are bound to feel intimidated and anxious
notes.note: be bound to（必然会）语气比 will 重，强调因果的必然性。intimidated（胆怯）与 anxious（焦虑）一个说面对外部、一个说内心状态。

notes.mark: leads to failure before the actual battle even begins
notes.note: 全段最有力的收尾：败在开打之前。用 before ... even begins 这个时间状语制造荒诞感，比说 it is harmful 有力十倍。

paragraphs.analysis: 主语链条是：寓意 → 缺乏自信 → 我们 → 这一心理障碍。从抽象概念切到 we 拉近读者，再抽回抽象概念作总结。哲理类文章大量用 we，因为讲的是普遍人性。

paragraphs.text: In my view, building and maintaining self-confidence is the prerequisite for success. To achieve this, we should accurately evaluate our strengths and weaknesses rather than being paralyzed by self-doubt. When confronted with hardships, we must firmly believe in our potential. As the famous saying goes, “Confidence is the first step on the road to success.”

notes.mark: building and maintaining self-confidence
notes.note: 动名词短语作主语。build 是建立、maintain 是维持，两个动词说明自信不是一次性的成就而是持续的过程。

notes.mark: accurately evaluate our strengths and weaknesses
notes.note: accurately（准确地）这个副词很要紧：文章反对的是低估自己，但也不鼓励盲目自大。一个副词把立场校准到「客观评估」而非「一味打鸡血」。

notes.mark: rather than being paralyzed by self-doubt
notes.note: paralyzed（瘫痪的）呼应第二段的「未战先败」，意象前后统一。

notes.mark: As the famous saying goes
notes.note: 名言收尾是哲理类文章的常规打法。引语要短、要贴题，不必追求冷僻。

paragraphs.analysis: 三句话：定性（自信是前提）→ 方法（准确评估）→ 态度（坚信潜力），最后名言收束。注意 accurately 和 firmly 这两个副词分工——一个管理性，一个管意志。

highlights.en: what makes the picture thought-provoking is ...
highlights.zh: 这幅画发人深省之处在于
highlights.why: 主语从句起句，用来在复杂画面里划重点。

highlights.en: distort our perception of reality and magnify the difficulties we face
highlights.zh: 扭曲我们对现实的认知、放大我们面对的困难
highlights.why: 心理类话题的核心动词组合。

highlights.en: underestimate our own abilities and overestimate the obstacles
highlights.zh: 低估自己的能力、高估面前的障碍
highlights.why: under-/over- 对仗，任何「认知偏差」话题都能用。

highlights.en: leads to failure before the actual battle even begins
highlights.zh: 在真正的较量开始之前就已经失败
highlights.why: 描述心理障碍后果的高分表达。

highlights.en: be bound to
highlights.zh: 必然会
highlights.why: 比 will 更重的必然性表达，用于论证因果。

takeaway: 哲理类漫画的第二段最容易写飘。破解办法是让寓意句的动词直接从画面里长出来——画里在「变形、变大」，寓意就写 distort、magnify；再用一句 much like the players in the picture 把论述钉回图上。

title: 道歉信：忘还房东的音乐 CD
prompt: You have just come back from Canada and found a music CD in your luggage that you forgot to return to Bob, your landlord there. Write him a letter to make an apology and suggest a solution. Write your letter with no less than 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter; use “Li Ming” instead.

outline.label: 称呼
outline.purpose: 写给熟人，直接用名字 Dear Bob

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 致歉并交代事实
outline.purpose: 先道歉，再说清楚发生了什么，不绕弯子

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 解释与解决方案
outline.purpose: 简短解释原因（不辩解）+ 给出可执行的补救办法

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 再次致歉并致谢
outline.purpose: 重申歉意，顺带感谢对方过去的照顾

outline.label: 落款
outline.purpose: Yours sincerely + Li Ming

paragraphs.text: Dear Bob,

I am writing to express my sincere apology to you. I have just returned to China from Canada, and to my great dismay, I found a music CD in my luggage that I borrowed from you but forgot to return before my departure.

notes.mark: I am writing to express my sincere apology
notes.note: 道歉信第一句必须是道歉本身，不能先寒暄。sincere 定调，后面所有解释都不能显得像推卸。

notes.mark: to my great dismay
notes.note: 插入语交代发现时的心情。dismay（懊恼）比 surprise 重，表明「我自己也很过意不去」，而不是轻描淡写。

notes.mark: that I borrowed from you but forgot to return
notes.note: 定语从句一句话说清事实：借了、忘还了。道歉信里的事实陈述要短，越啰嗦越像找借口。

paragraphs.analysis: 两句话：先道歉，再交代事实。注意主语全是 I——与 2007 年建议信刻意躲开人称的写法正好相反。道歉信必须让「我」站在句首承担责任。

paragraphs.text: I was in such a hurry packing my belongings that I completely overlooked it. I know this CD is one of your favorites, and I am truly sorry for the inconvenience my negligence may have caused you. To make up for my mistake, I will mail it back to you via international express delivery tomorrow morning. It should reach you within a week, and I will certainly cover the postage.

notes.mark: I was in such a hurry packing my belongings that I completely overlooked it
notes.note: 解释只给一句，且用 completely overlooked（完全疏忽了）自认失误，不说 it was not my fault。解释和辩解的区别就在有没有把责任推出去。

notes.mark: I know this CD is one of your favorites
notes.note: 站在对方角度说话，承认这件东西对他有价值。道歉的诚意来自「我知道你在意什么」，不是来自形容词堆砌。

notes.mark: my negligence
notes.note: 用名词 negligence（疏忽）给自己的行为定性，比 my mistake 更具体也更坦诚。

notes.mark: via international express delivery
notes.note: 方案要具体到可信：寄国际快递而不是平邮，本身就是态度。写 I will send it back 就太空。

notes.mark: It should reach you within a week
notes.note: 主语切换成「它」，给出时间预期，让对方安心。这是全信唯一一次跳出第一人称，正好落在最需要客观感的物流承诺上。

notes.mark: I will certainly cover the postage
notes.note: 主动承担费用，打消对方顾虑。certainly 表态坚决，是补救诚意的最后一块拼图。

paragraphs.analysis: 解释一句、共情一句、方案三句。方案部分回答了「怎么寄、多久到、谁付钱」三个问题——道歉信的分数大头在方案的可执行性，不在道歉词有多华丽。

paragraphs.text: Once again, I apologize for my carelessness and thank you for your generous hospitality during my stay in Canada.

notes.mark: Once again, I apologize for my carelessness
notes.note: 首尾各道歉一次，中间放解释和方案，这是道歉信的标准三明治结构。

notes.mark: thank you for your generous hospitality
notes.note: 把话题从「这件错事」拉回「你对我的好」，收尾的温度就出来了。道歉信不要停在负面情绪上。

paragraphs.text:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

highlights.en: to my great dismay
highlights.zh: 令我十分懊恼的是
highlights.why: 插入语，交代发现问题时的心情，比 unfortunately 有分量。

highlights.en: I am truly sorry for the inconvenience my negligence may have caused you
highlights.zh: 我的疏忽可能给你带来的不便，我深感抱歉
highlights.why: 道歉核心句，negligence 自我定性，may have caused 弱化推测。

highlights.en: To make up for my mistake, I will ...
highlights.zh: 为弥补我的过失，我将……
highlights.why: 从道歉切换到方案的路标句。

highlights.en: via international express delivery
highlights.zh: 通过国际快递
highlights.why: 让补救方案显得具体可信的细节词。

highlights.en: your generous hospitality
highlights.zh: 你慷慨的招待
highlights.why: 结尾致谢的现成搭配。

takeaway: 道歉信和建议信的主语策略完全相反：建议信要躲开人称、对事不对人；道歉信要让 I 反复站在句首主动认领。唯一一次切成事物作主语的机会，留给「东西什么时候能到」这类需要客观感的承诺。

title: 你我一起，走南闯北：合作的力量
genre: 漫画作文 · 正面弘扬
prompt:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should describe the drawing briefly, explain its intended meaning, and then give your comments.

【漫画】两个残疾人，左边的失去左腿、右边的失去右腿，两人互相搂着肩膀把剩下的腿配合起来，扔掉拐杖大步向前。图下文字：「你我一起，走南闯北」。

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 描述画面
outline.purpose: 先写动作，再交代各自的残缺，最后写他们如何配合——因果顺序而非视觉顺序

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 阐释价值
outline.purpose: 合作与互助的普遍意义，配「竞争激烈、各有长短」两条论据

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 呼吁践行
outline.purpose: 教育与日常两个层面，收在和谐社会的愿景上

paragraphs.text: As is vividly depicted in the drawing, two disabled men are walking vigorously down a road. Since one is missing his left leg and the other his right, neither can walk easily on his own. However, by putting their arms around each other’s shoulders and supporting each other, they manage to stride forward independently, leaving their crutches behind. The caption reads, “You and me together, we can travel anywhere.”

notes.mark: walking vigorously
notes.note: vigorously（精神饱满地）与两人身体的残缺形成反差。描述正面画面时，副词要往上扬，与 2005 年 desperately 那种往下压的用法正好相反。

notes.mark: Since one is missing his left leg and the other his right
notes.note: 用 Since 引导原因状语，先交代残缺再说结果。描述段不必严格按视觉顺序，按因果顺序写读者更容易跟上。注意 the other his right 省略了 is missing，是地道的省略。

notes.mark: neither can walk easily on his own
notes.note: neither（两者都不）强调个体的局限性，为下一句的「合作」制造必要性。这一句是全段的逻辑枢纽。

notes.mark: they manage to stride forward independently
notes.note: manage to（设法做到）暗示不容易，independently（独立地）与前面的 neither ... on his own 呼应——合作之后反而实现了独立，这是画面最妙的一层意思。

notes.mark: leaving their crutches behind
notes.note: 扔掉拐杖这个细节不能漏。它是「合作的力量超过了外部辅助」的视觉证据，也是描述段里最有力的一笔。

paragraphs.analysis: 顺序是：动作 → 原因（各自的残缺）→ 方式（如何配合）→ 结果（丢掉拐杖）→ 字幕。这条因果链让描述段本身就已经在论证了。

paragraphs.text: The profound meaning of the cartoon is straightforward: cooperation and mutual support are of vital importance in our lives. In modern society, competition is increasingly fierce, and almost no one can overcome all difficulties alone. Everyone has their own strengths and weaknesses. Just like the two men in the picture, if we can recognize our limitations and join hands with others, we can overcome seemingly insurmountable obstacles and achieve a win-win situation.

notes.mark: cooperation and mutual support are of vital importance
notes.note: 正面弘扬类文章的点题句直接给出价值判断。be of vital importance 比 are very important 正式一档，of + 抽象名词是常用的形容词替换法。

notes.mark: competition is increasingly fierce
notes.note: 交代时代背景。increasingly（日益）说明这是一个持续变化的趋势，而不是静止的事实。

notes.mark: almost no one can overcome all difficulties alone
notes.note: almost 一词很关键：不把话说满。绝对化的断言在议论文里是风险，一个副词就把它变成了稳妥的判断。

notes.mark: Just like the two men in the picture
notes.note: 论理中途回扣画面。与 2007 年的 much like the players in the picture 同一手法——抽象论述必须定期回到图上。

notes.mark: seemingly insurmountable obstacles
notes.note: seemingly（看似）修饰 insurmountable（不可逾越的），先承认困难之大，再反衬合作之强。这个副词让论证有了层次。

notes.mark: a win-win situation
notes.note: 现代社会与职场话题的高频名词，正面弘扬类文章的标配落点。

paragraphs.analysis: 论据只有两条：竞争激烈（外部环境）和各有长短（个体现实）。正面弘扬类文章不需要复杂论证，把「为什么必须合作」的两个前提说清楚就够了。

paragraphs.text: In my opinion, the spirit of teamwork should be highly advocated and cultivated. On the one hand, parents and schools should teach the younger generation how to cooperate with others. On the other hand, in our daily work, we should always be ready to offer a helping hand to our partners. Only through sincere cooperation can we build a harmonious and prosperous society.

notes.mark: the spirit of teamwork should be highly advocated and cultivated
notes.note: 被动语态把「团队精神」顶到主语位置，突出概念本身。advocate（倡导）和 cultivate（培养）一个说态度、一个说行动。

notes.mark: parents and schools
notes.note: 对策要落到具体主体。教育层面就写家长和学校，比笼统的 society 有说服力。

notes.mark: offer a helping hand
notes.note: 日常层面的对策要具体到一个可做的动作。这个短语比 help each other 生动。

notes.mark: Only through sincere cooperation can we build
notes.note: Only 引导的倒装收尾，与 2005 年的 Only in this way 同类。注意 sincere（真诚的）这个形容词——呼应画面里两人是真的搂着肩膀，不是形式上的结盟。

notes.mark: a harmonious and prosperous society
notes.note: 正面类文章的标准愿景搭配，和谐 + 繁荣两个形容词并列收尾。

paragraphs.analysis: 两个层面：教育（长远）和日常（当下）。与批判类文章「教育 + 法律」的软硬搭配不同，正面弘扬类用的是「长期 + 眼前」的时间搭配。

highlights.en: be of vital importance
highlights.zh: 至关重要
highlights.why: of + 抽象名词替换形容词，正式度高一档。

highlights.en: almost no one can overcome all difficulties alone
highlights.zh: 几乎没有人能独自克服所有困难
highlights.why: 论证合作必要性的前提句，almost 避免绝对化。

highlights.en: seemingly insurmountable obstacles
highlights.zh: 看似不可逾越的障碍
highlights.why: 先承认困难再反衬办法，任何励志类话题通用。

highlights.en: achieve a win-win situation
highlights.zh: 实现双赢
highlights.why: 合作、谈判、国际关系类话题的现成落点。

highlights.en: Only through sincere cooperation can we build ...
highlights.zh: 只有通过真诚的合作，我们才能建立……
highlights.why: Only 倒装收尾，语法采分点。

takeaway: 正面弘扬类和批判类的骨架相同，副词方向相反：批判类用 desperately、selfishly 往下压，弘扬类用 vigorously、sincerely 往上扬。第三段的对策搭配也不同——批判类是「教育 + 法律」的软硬组合，弘扬类是「长期 + 当下」的时间组合。

title: 致报社编辑：限塑令为什么没管住白色污染
prompt: Restrictions on the use of plastic bags have not been so successful in some regions. “White pollution” is still going on. Write a letter to the editor(s) of your local newspaper to give your opinions briefly and make two or three suggestions. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead.

outline.label: 称呼
outline.purpose: 写给报社编辑，用 Dear Editor

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 表明关切
outline.purpose: 点出问题并说明写信缘由，一句话完成

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 观点 + 两条建议
outline.purpose: 先分析原因（公众意识不足），再给罚款与研发两条建议

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 借媒体发声
outline.purpose: 希望通过报纸引起关注，呼应「写给报社」这个特定收件人

outline.label: 落款
outline.purpose: Yours sincerely + Li Ming

paragraphs.text: Dear Editor,
I am writing to express my deep concern regarding the ongoing “white pollution” in our city, despite the recent restrictions on the use of plastic bags.

notes.mark: my deep concern
notes.note: 致编辑信的立场是「关切」而非「投诉」。concern 一词把作者定位成有社会责任感的市民，而不是发牢骚的人。

notes.mark: the ongoing “white pollution”
notes.note: ongoing（仍在持续的）一个词就点出了题目的核心矛盾——政策出台了，问题还在。这是全信的立论基础。

notes.mark: despite the recent restrictions
notes.note: 用 despite 把「限塑令」和「污染依旧」放进同一句，让转折自己说话，比写两句再加 however 紧凑。

paragraphs.analysis: 一句话同时装下：写信目的、问题现状、政策背景。小作文只有 100 词，第一段必须这样压缩。

paragraphs.text: In my opinion, the primary reason for this failure is that many citizens still lack adequate environmental awareness and prioritize short-term convenience over ecological protection. To effectively address this pressing issue, I would like to make two suggestions. First, it is essential that the government impose heavier fines on supermarkets and retailers that continue to provide free plastic bags. Second, more research funds should be allocated to the development of affordable and biodegradable alternatives to traditional plastic products.

notes.mark: many citizens still lack adequate environmental awareness
notes.note: 剖析原因时主语切成被批判的群体。这一步让信件具备了社会评论的属性，而不只是私人抱怨。

notes.mark: prioritize short-term convenience over ecological protection
notes.note: prioritize A over B（把 A 置于 B 之上）是分析价值取舍的万能句式。短期便利 vs 生态保护，一句话把矛盾的本质说清了。

notes.mark: pressing issue
notes.note: pressing（紧迫的）给问题定级，为下面提出强硬建议做铺垫。

notes.mark: it is essential that the government impose heavier fines
notes.note: 形式主语 + 虚拟语气（impose 不加 s）。信是写给报社的，真正的执行者是政府，所以不能用祈使句，只能用这种「建议某方应当如何」的结构。

notes.mark: more research funds should be allocated
notes.note: 被动语态作主语，强调资源倾斜这个动作本身而不追问谁来拨款。写给媒体的建议用被动更专业。

notes.mark: affordable and biodegradable
notes.note: 环保话题的核心形容词对：既要可降解（技术），又要买得起（经济）。只说 biodegradable 会显得不接地气。

paragraphs.analysis: 结构是「原因 → 过渡 → 建议一 → 建议二」。两条建议一条针对商家（罚款），一条针对技术（研发），一堵一疏，覆盖面立刻完整。

paragraphs.text: I hope this phenomenon will draw more public attention through your esteemed newspaper. Thank you for your time.

notes.mark: draw more public attention through your esteemed newspaper
notes.note: 这一句是这封信区别于普通建议信的地方——必须点明「借你们的版面呼吁公众」，否则写给报社就没有意义了。esteemed（尊敬的）是对媒体的礼貌用词。

paragraphs.text:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

highlights.en: I am writing to express my deep concern regarding ...
highlights.zh: 我写信是为了表达我对……的深切关注
highlights.why: 致媒体、致有关部门信件的开头定式。

highlights.en: prioritize short-term convenience over ecological protection
highlights.zh: 把短期便利置于生态保护之上
highlights.why: prioritize A over B，分析价值取舍的万能句式。

highlights.en: it is essential that the government impose heavier fines on ...
highlights.zh: 政府必须对……处以更重的罚款
highlights.why: 形式主语 + 虚拟语气，建议第三方采取行动的标准写法。

highlights.en: affordable and biodegradable alternatives
highlights.zh: 价格可承受且可降解的替代品
highlights.why: 环保话题的核心形容词对。

highlights.en: draw more public attention through your esteemed newspaper
highlights.zh: 通过贵报引起更多公众关注
highlights.why: 致编辑信的收尾，点明借助媒体这一渠道。

takeaway: 写给报社的信要记住收件人的特殊性：报社既不是问题的制造者也不是解决者，而是传播渠道。所以建议要用「政府应当」「资金应被投入」这类第三方句式，结尾必须回到「借贵报呼吁」这一层。

title: 网络的「近」与「远」
genre: 漫画作文 · 双刃剑辩证
prompt:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should describe the drawing briefly, explain its intended meaning, and then give your comments.

【漫画】画面主体是一张巨大的蜘蛛网（象征互联网），网的每个格子里都有一个人坐在自己的电脑隔间里盯着屏幕。他们被网络连在一起，彼此之间却被隔板挡住，互不交流。图下文字：「网络的『近』与『远』」。

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 描述画面
outline.purpose: 抓住「被网连着却被隔板挡着」这一组矛盾，最后点出字幕的反讽

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 双刃剑辩证
outline.purpose: 先写「近」（科技带来便利），再写「远」（沉迷导致疏离），两面都要落到具体表现

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 提出平衡
outline.purpose: 不否定网络，主张走出虚拟隔间、恢复面对面交流

paragraphs.text: As is vividly shown in the cartoon, many people are sitting in their respective compartments, staring blankly at their computer screens. While they are connected by a massive web symbolizing the Internet, they are physically isolated from one another by solid partitions. The caption at the bottom reads, “The Internet: Near or Far?”, which adds a touch of profound irony to the picture.

notes.mark: staring blankly at their computer screens
notes.note: blankly（茫然地）刻画网民盯屏幕时的空洞状态。这个副词为第二段的「情感疏离」埋了伏笔——描述段的用词要为论理段服务。

notes.mark: While they are connected by a massive web
notes.note: 用 While 引导让步，把「连接」和「隔离」这组矛盾压进一句话。这幅画的全部张力就在这一句里。

notes.mark: symbolizing the Internet
notes.note: 现在分词作定语，一笔点明蜘蛛网的象征义。漫画里的象征物必须当场解释，不能指望阅卷人自己领会。

notes.mark: they are physically isolated from one another by solid partitions
notes.note: physically（物理上）这个副词是精心选的，它与第二段的 emotionally alienated（情感上疏远）构成维度上的对照。

notes.mark: adds a touch of profound irony
notes.note: 点出字幕的反讽性质。a touch of（一丝）避免把话说得过重，profound（深刻的）又保证了分量。

paragraphs.analysis: 描述段只有三句，但完成了「状态 → 矛盾 → 字幕」三步。核心是第二句的 While 让步结构——凡是画面本身含有对立的漫画，描述段就该用一个让步从句把对立装进去。

paragraphs.text: The intended meaning of this drawing is to reveal the double-edged nature of the Internet. On the one hand, cyberspace has brought unprecedented convenience to our lives, enabling us to communicate instantly with people from all corners of the globe. In this sense, the Internet brings us closer. On the other hand, a growing number of people have become so addicted to the virtual world that they neglect real-life interactions. As a result, family members and friends residing in the same house or neighborhood are growing emotionally alienated, creating an undeniable sense of distance.

notes.mark: the double-edged nature of the Internet
notes.note: 点题句直接给出「双刃剑」这个定性。凡是题目自带正反两面（网络、手机、AI、社交媒体），第二段就必须一分为二，不能只批判。

notes.mark: cyberspace has brought unprecedented convenience
notes.note: 谈「近」的时候主语是科技本身（cyberspace / the Internet），表示科技在主动为人服务。

notes.mark: In this sense, the Internet brings us closer.
notes.note: 短句收束正面论述，且直接呼应标题里的「近」。回扣题目字幕是漫画作文的隐性采分点。

notes.mark: a growing number of people have become so addicted
notes.note: 谈「远」的时候主语切回人。这个切换很关键：疏远不是网络造成的，是人自己沉迷造成的——责任归属一变，立意就深了一层。

notes.mark: residing in the same house or neighborhood
notes.note: 现在分词短语制造反差：住在同一屋檐下却情感疏远。具体的空间描写让抽象的「疏离」有了画面。

notes.mark: emotionally alienated
notes.note: 与第一段的 physically isolated 形成完美的维度对比：物理上被隔断、情感上被疏远。两个副词一前一后，全文因此有了骨架。

paragraphs.analysis: 标准的双刃剑段落：定性 → On the one hand 正面（主语是科技）→ 小结回扣「近」→ On the other hand 负面（主语切回人）→ 后果 → 回扣「远」。主语的切换本身就是论点。

paragraphs.text: In conclusion, while we should fully utilize the advantages of the Internet, we must not let it dominate our lives. It is high time that we stepped out of our virtual cubicles, spent more time with our loved ones, and engaged in more face-to-face communication.

notes.mark: while we should fully utilize the advantages of the Internet, we must not let it dominate our lives
notes.note: 结论必须同时保留正反两面。双刃剑题目最忌讳结尾一边倒，那会推翻第二段自己给过的让步。

notes.mark: It is high time that we stepped out
notes.note: It is high time that + 过去式，虚拟语气的固定句型（不是 step 也不是 to step）。这是一个高含金量的语法采分点，同时表达「早该如此」的紧迫感。

notes.mark: our virtual cubicles
notes.note: 回扣第一段画面里的隔间。结尾能把意象接回开头，文章的完成度立刻不一样。

notes.mark: face-to-face communication
notes.note: 针对虚拟交流弊端的标准对策词，复合形容词，直接点明行动方向。

paragraphs.analysis: 只有两句：一句守住辩证立场，一句给出三个并列的具体动作（走出隔间、陪家人、面对面交流）。抽象呼吁必须落到可做的动作上。

highlights.en: the double-edged nature of ...
highlights.zh: ……的双刃剑属性
highlights.why: 科技、社交媒体、AI 类题目的定性词。

highlights.en: unprecedented convenience
highlights.zh: 前所未有的便利
highlights.why: 肯定科技正面价值的标准搭配。

highlights.en: so addicted to the virtual world that they neglect real-life interactions
highlights.zh: 沉迷虚拟世界以致忽视了现实中的交往
highlights.why: so ... that 结果状语，批判沉迷类现象通用。

highlights.en: physically isolated / emotionally alienated
highlights.zh: 物理上被隔离／情感上被疏远
highlights.why: 一组维度对照的副词，任何「表面连接、实则疏远」的话题都能用。

highlights.en: It is high time that we stepped out of ...
highlights.zh: 我们早该走出……了
highlights.why: 虚拟语气固定句型，从句用过去式，语法采分点。

takeaway: 双刃剑题目的主语切换是核心技巧：讲好处时让科技作主语（科技在服务人），讲坏处时把主语切回人（是人自己沉迷）。这样批判的矛头指向使用者而非工具，结论才能站得住——既不否定技术，也不放过问题。

title: 招募启事：国际会议志愿者
prompt: You are supposed to write for the Students’ Union a notice to recruit volunteers for an international conference on global integration. The notice should include the basic information of the conference, the requirements for the volunteers, and the way to apply. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the notice. Use “Li Ming” instead.

outline.label: 标题
outline.purpose: 通知类应用文要有标题，居中写 Notice

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 会议信息
outline.purpose: 目的 + 时间地点 + 招募人数，一句话交代完基本信息

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 志愿者要求
outline.purpose: 先说职责，再由职责推出要求，最后加一条优先条件

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 申请方式
outline.purpose: 投递地址 + 截止时间，缺一不可

outline.label: 落款
outline.purpose: 机构署名，通知不写个人名字

paragraphs.text: Notice

To ensure the smooth running of the upcoming International Conference on Global Integration, which is scheduled to be held on our campus from May 15th to 17th, the Students’ Union is currently recruiting 20 volunteers.

notes.mark: To ensure the smooth running of
notes.note: 目的状语开头，先说「为什么办这件事」。通知类应用文不写 I am writing——它不是信，没有写信人和收信人的私人关系。

notes.mark: which is scheduled to be held on our campus from May 15th to 17th
notes.note: 定语从句一次性塞进时间和地点。通知的信息密度必须高，能用从句解决的绝不另起一句。

notes.mark: the Students’ Union is currently recruiting 20 volunteers
notes.note: 主语是发布通知的机构，不是「我」。这是通知与书信最根本的区别——发文主体是组织。

notes.mark: 20 volunteers
notes.note: 招募人数要写具体数字。通知里凡是能量化的信息都不要用 some、several 这类模糊词。

paragraphs.analysis: 一句话装下目的、名称、时间、地点、主体、人数六项信息。靠的是「目的状语 + 定语从句 + 主句」的三层嵌套，这是公文英语的典型密度。

paragraphs.text: The responsibilities will mainly involve reception, simultaneous interpretation, and logistical support. Therefore, applicants are expected to have a good command of fluent English and outstanding communication skills. Furthermore, previous volunteering experience in organizing large-scale events will be considered a distinct advantage.

notes.mark: The responsibilities will mainly involve
notes.note: 主语是「职责」而不是「你们要做的事」。先摆事实，再由事实推出要求，逻辑顺序比直接列条件更专业。

notes.mark: simultaneous interpretation
notes.note: 同声传译。这个词一出，会议的规格和对英语能力的要求就都不言自明了——用专业名词代替形容词是公文的省字技巧。

notes.mark: applicants are expected to have
notes.note: 主语切换成 applicants（申请人），配被动式的 are expected to。既不用 you（太直接），也不用 we require（太强硬）。

notes.mark: a good command of fluent English
notes.note: have a good command of 是「精通某语言」的固定搭配，比 be good at English 正式得多。

notes.mark: previous volunteering experience in organizing large-scale events will be considered a distinct advantage
notes.note: 把「经验」作主语配被动语态，是招聘公告最地道的写法。distinct advantage（明显优势）准确表达了「有经验者优先」这层附加条件，而不是硬性门槛。

paragraphs.analysis: 三句话的主语依次是：职责 → 申请人 → 经验。全部是事和物，没有一个人称代词。通知类应用文的语气就是靠这种「无人称」建立起来的。

paragraphs.text: Those who are interested in this position should send their resumes to volunteer@university.edu.cn no later than May 1st. We look forward to your active participation.

notes.mark: Those who are interested in this position
notes.note: Those who 结构是招募、招聘类通知呼吁行动的标准主语起手式，精准锁定目标读者。

notes.mark: no later than May 1st
notes.note: 截止时间必须明确到日。通知漏掉截止时间是要点不全，直接扣分。

notes.mark: We look forward to your active participation
notes.note: 全文唯一一次出现人称代词 We，代表机构而非个人，放在最后一句作邀请，分寸正好。

paragraphs.text: Students’ Union

highlights.en: To ensure the smooth running of ...
highlights.zh: 为确保……顺利进行
highlights.why: 通知类应用文的目的状语开头。

highlights.en: which is scheduled to be held on ... from ... to ...
highlights.zh: 定于……在……举行
highlights.why: 一个从句塞进时间地点，公文的省字写法。

highlights.en: applicants are expected to have a good command of ...
highlights.zh: 申请者需精通……
highlights.why: 招募条件的标准句式，无人称、不强硬。

highlights.en: will be considered a distinct advantage
highlights.zh: 将被视为明显优势
highlights.why: 表达「优先条件」而非硬性门槛。

highlights.en: Those who are interested should ... no later than ...
highlights.zh: 有意者请于……前……
highlights.why: 呼吁行动 + 截止时间，通知的固定收尾。

takeaway: 通知不是信：没有 Dear、没有 I、没有 Yours sincerely，落款写机构。全篇主语只能是「机构、职责、申请人、经验」这类事物，唯一允许出现的人称是代表组织的 We，且只放在最后一句。

title: 文化火锅：既美味又营养
genre: 漫画作文 · 正面弘扬
prompt:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should describe the drawing briefly, explain its intended meaning, and then give your comments.

【漫画】一口沸腾的火锅，里面装满了各种中西文化元素：毕加索、佛、莎士比亚、老舍、功夫、爱因斯坦、京剧、天鹅湖、道等。图下文字：「文化『火锅』，既美味又营养」。

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 描述画面
outline.purpose: 锅 → 中西元素罗列 → 字幕，罗列时中西交替出现

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 阐释价值
outline.purpose: 点明文化融合的意义，用火锅本身的比喻贯穿论证

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 表明态度
outline.purpose: 继承本国文化 + 吸收外来文明，收在地球村的愿景上

paragraphs.text: As is vividly illustrated in the drawing, a boiling hotpot contains a wide variety of cultural elements from both China and the West, ranging from Buddhism, Taoism, and Kung Fu to Shakespeare, Einstein, and Swan Lake. The caption below reads, “Cultural ‘hotpot’, both delicious and nutritious,” which strikes a deep chord with the readers.

notes.mark: a boiling hotpot
notes.note: boiling（沸腾的）不只是写实，它同时暗示了文化碰撞的热烈状态。描述正面画面时，一个动态形容词就能定下基调。

notes.mark: ranging from Buddhism, Taoism, and Kung Fu to Shakespeare, Einstein, and Swan Lake
notes.note: ranging from A to B 是罗列的最佳结构，比 there are A, B, C, D 高级。注意中方三项在前、西方三项在后，分组清晰，比中西混杂着列更有条理。

notes.mark: which strikes a deep chord with the readers
notes.note: strike a chord with（引起共鸣）。描述段收尾不评价画面荒诞与否，而是说它「引起共鸣」——这是正面弘扬类文章特有的收法，与批判类的 ironic contrast 正好相反。

paragraphs.analysis: 只有两句话。正面类漫画的描述段不需要写得多长，把象征物（火锅）、内容物（中西元素）、字幕三样交代清楚即可，省下的字数留给第二段的论证。

paragraphs.text: The intended meaning of this picture is straightforward: it highlights the significance of cultural integration and diversity. With the rapid acceleration of globalization, cultural exchange has become an unavoidable trend. Just like the diverse ingredients in a hotpot that blend together to create a delicious flavor, different cultures can learn from and complement each other. The collision and fusion of Eastern and Western cultures not only promote mutual understanding among nations but also inject new vitality into human civilization.

notes.mark: cultural integration and diversity
notes.note: 文化类话题的核心名词对：融合（过程）与多样（结果）。两个词同时出现，立意才完整。

notes.mark: an unavoidable trend
notes.note: 把文化交流定性为「不可避免的趋势」，等于先把「要不要交流」这个问题关掉，文章只讨论「怎么交流」。这一步定性决定了第三段的立场。

notes.mark: Just like the diverse ingredients in a hotpot that blend together to create a delicious flavor
notes.note: 整篇文章最好的一句：把画面的比喻直接借来当论据。食材各异却能炖出一锅好味道——不用抽象说理，比喻自己完成了论证。

notes.mark: learn from and complement each other
notes.note: complement（互补）而不是 compete（竞争），一个动词就确立了文化之间的平等关系。

notes.mark: The collision and fusion of Eastern and Western cultures
notes.note: 长名词短语作主语，学术感强，是提升文章理论高度的常规手段。collision（碰撞）与 fusion（融合）一对，承认交流中有冲突，不是一味唱和。

notes.mark: inject new vitality into human civilization
notes.note: inject ... into（注入）是抽象概念的高级动词搭配，比 bring 生动。

paragraphs.analysis: 论证的主线是那个火锅比喻。凡是漫画本身自带比喻的题目，第二段最省力也最漂亮的写法就是把这个比喻延伸下去，而不是另起炉灶讲大道理。

paragraphs.text: In my opinion, we should adopt an open and inclusive attitude towards diverse cultures. While inheriting and carrying forward our own traditional culture, we must actively embrace the excellent achievements of other cultures. Only in this way can we contribute to a more colorful and harmonious global village.

notes.mark: an open and inclusive attitude
notes.note: 文化类话题的核心态度形容词对：开放（对外）与包容（对内心）。几乎所有文化题的第三段都能用这一对。

notes.mark: While inheriting and carrying forward our own traditional culture
notes.note: While 引导的分词状语，先立住「继承本国文化」这个前提，再谈吸收外来。次序不能颠倒——文化题一旦只谈吸收不谈继承，立意就偏了。

notes.mark: actively embrace
notes.note: actively（主动地）是关键副词。它把「接受外来文化」从被动承受改成了主动选择，态度立刻积极。

notes.mark: a more colorful and harmonious global village
notes.note: 愿景的标配搭配。colorful 呼应火锅的丰富，harmonious 呼应融合，两个形容词都从前文长出来，不是硬贴上去的。

paragraphs.analysis: 三句话：态度 → 两个层面的做法 → 愿景。注意 While 从句的顺序设计，「先继承再吸收」这个先后关系本身就是立场。

highlights.en: ranging from A, B, and C to D, E, and F
highlights.zh: 从 A、B、C 到 D、E、F
highlights.why: 罗列多项内容的最佳结构，比 there are 高级。

highlights.en: strike a deep chord with the readers
highlights.zh: 引起读者深深的共鸣
highlights.why: 正面类漫画描述段的收尾，替代批判类的 ironic contrast。

highlights.en: learn from and complement each other
highlights.zh: 相互学习、彼此互补
highlights.why: 确立平等关系的动词组合，文化、国际关系类通用。

highlights.en: inject new vitality into ...
highlights.zh: 为……注入新的活力
highlights.why: 抽象概念的高级动词搭配。

highlights.en: adopt an open and inclusive attitude towards ...
highlights.zh: 对……采取开放包容的态度
highlights.why: 文化类话题第三段的核心态度句。

takeaway: 漫画自带比喻时（火锅、拼图、木桶、齿轮），第二段最漂亮的写法是把这个比喻延伸成论据——Just like the ingredients in a hotpot ... 一句话顶三句抽象说理。另起炉灶讲大道理反而浪费了题目给的素材。

title: 推荐信：向朋友推荐一部电影
prompt: Write a letter to a friend of yours to recommend one of your favorite movies and give reasons for your recommendation. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead.

outline.label: 称呼
outline.purpose: 写给朋友，直接用名字

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 亮出推荐
outline.purpose: 一句话说清推荐什么、并预判对方会喜欢

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 两条理由
outline.purpose: 主题励志 + 演技出色，主语从「我」切到「电影本身」

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 发出邀请
outline.purpose: 建议去看 + 期待交流，把推荐变成互动

outline.label: 落款
outline.purpose: Yours sincerely + Li Ming

paragraphs.text: Dear Bob,
I am writing to enthusiastically recommend one of my favorite movies to you, The Pursuit of Happyness, which I believe you will thoroughly enjoy.

notes.mark: enthusiastically recommend
notes.note: 写给朋友的信可以带感情。enthusiastically（热情地）这个副词在正式公函里会显得过头，在私人推荐信里恰到好处——语域要跟着收件人走。

notes.mark: which I believe you will thoroughly enjoy
notes.note: 定语从句里插入 I believe，先替对方预判感受。推荐的说服力有一半来自「我了解你的口味」这个暗示。

paragraphs.analysis: 一句话完成推荐。片名之后紧跟一个定语从句，既补充了理由的预告，也避免了第一段只有干巴巴一个书名。

paragraphs.text: The primary reason for my recommendation is its deeply inspiring theme. Based on a true story, the film depicts a struggling salesman who faces homelessness and countless hardships, yet ultimately achieves success through sheer perseverance and unwavering faith. Furthermore, the outstanding acting vividly conveys the importance of never giving up on one’s dreams, a message that I found incredibly motivating.

notes.mark: The primary reason for my recommendation is
notes.note: 主语从「我」切到「原因」。如果通篇写 I like it because...，理由就只是个人口味；把原因、电影、演技依次推上主语位置，推荐才显得客观扎实。

notes.mark: Based on a true story
notes.note: 分词短语开头，一句话给电影加上可信度。推荐类文章要善用这种「一句话卖点」。

notes.mark: countless hardships, yet ultimately achieves success
notes.note: yet 制造转折，把「困境」和「成功」压进一句。人物介绍要写出弧光，平铺直叙的剧情复述是没有说服力的。

notes.mark: sheer perseverance and unwavering faith
notes.note: sheer（纯粹的、十足的）和 unwavering（坚定不移的）两个形容词把抽象品质写实了。推荐信的分数很大一部分在这类修饰语上。

notes.mark: a message that I found incredibly motivating
notes.note: 同位语收尾，把话题从电影拉回「我的感受」。理由段前面全是客观陈述，最后一句回到主观，冷热搭配才像朋友说话。

paragraphs.analysis: 两条理由分别是主题和表演。主语链条：原因 → 电影 → 演技，一路都是客观事物，只在最后一个同位语里放进 I found，分寸拿捏得很准。

paragraphs.text: I highly suggest you watch it when you have time. I am looking forward to discussing it with you soon.

notes.mark: I highly suggest you watch it
notes.note: 注意 suggest 后的从句用动词原形 watch（虚拟语气），不是 to watch，也不是 watches。这是高频语法失分点。

notes.mark: looking forward to discussing it with you
notes.note: 把单向推荐变成双向约定，给这封信留了下文。私人信件的结尾最好都有这样一个「接下来」。

paragraphs.text:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

highlights.en: I am writing to enthusiastically recommend ... to you
highlights.zh: 我写信是想热情地向你推荐……
highlights.why: 私人推荐信开头，副词带出感情色彩。

highlights.en: The primary reason for my recommendation is ...
highlights.zh: 我推荐它的主要原因是
highlights.why: 把主语从「我」切到「原因」，让理由显得客观。

highlights.en: through sheer perseverance and unwavering faith
highlights.zh: 凭借纯粹的毅力和坚定的信念
highlights.why: 描述人物品质的高分搭配，励志类话题通用。

highlights.en: I highly suggest you watch it
highlights.zh: 我强烈建议你去看
highlights.why: suggest 后接动词原形，虚拟语气，常考语法点。

highlights.en: I am looking forward to discussing it with you
highlights.zh: 期待与你交流
highlights.why: 私人信件收尾，把推荐变成约定。

takeaway: 推荐信的语域要跟着收件人走：写给朋友可以用 enthusiastically、thoroughly 这类带感情的副词。但理由段仍要把主语切到「原因、作品、表演」这些客观事物上，否则通篇「我觉得好」是撑不起说服力的。

title: 旅程之「余」：游船身后的垃圾
genre: 漫画作文 · 现象批判
prompt:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should describe the drawing briefly, explain its intended meaning, and then give your comments.

【漫画】标题为「旅程之『余』」。画面是一处风景区，两个游客坐在小船上赏景拍照，但船驶过的湖面上漂着大量随手扔下的垃圾：塑料瓶、快餐盒、鱼骨头等。

outline.label: 第 1 段 · 描述画面
outline.purpose: 先写游客赏景（美），再转到身后的垃圾（丑），最后点出标题的双关

outline.label: 第 2 段 · 揭示问题
outline.purpose: 旅游业繁荣背后的环境破坏，落到「游客的不文明行为」这一具体成因

outline.label: 第 3 段 · 提出对策
outline.purpose: 严法重罚 + 全国性宣传教育，收在为后代保留自然之美

paragraphs.text: As is vividly depicted in the cartoon, two tourists are enjoying a boat trip on a beautiful lake, admiring the surrounding scenery. However, shockingly, the water behind their boat is covered with a huge amount of floating garbage, such as discarded plastic bottles and snack boxes, which they have casually thrown away. The caption reads “The ‘Remains’ of a Journey,” serving as a sharp and ironic pun.

notes.mark: enjoying a boat trip on a beautiful lake, admiring the surrounding scenery
notes.note: 先把美的一面写足。批判类漫画的描述段要先建立正面画面，反差才有落差。这里连用两个现在分词，画面松弛惬意。

notes.mark: However, shockingly
notes.note: 转折 + 情绪副词双重发力。shockingly（令人震惊地）与上一句的 enjoying、admiring 形成情绪上的急刹车。

notes.mark: which they have casually thrown away
notes.note: 定语从句明确指出垃圾的制造者就是这两个游客。不写这一句，画面就只是「湖里有垃圾」；写了，才成立「赏景的人正在毁景」这个矛盾。

notes.mark: casually
notes.note: 全段最狠的一个副词。casually（随手地、漫不经心地）与 shockingly 构成对照——旁观者震惊，当事人无感。冷漠感就出来了。

notes.mark: serving as a sharp and ironic pun
notes.note: 必须点破标题的双关：「余」既是旅程之余（闲暇），也是残余（垃圾）。中文双关不好直译，用 pun 一词说明其性质即可，不必强行翻译。

paragraphs.analysis: 结构是「美 → However 转 → 丑 → 责任归属 → 字幕双关」。注意副词的情绪配置：admiring（惬意）→ shockingly（震惊）→ casually（冷漠），三个词构成一条完整的情绪曲线。

paragraphs.text: The underlying meaning of the drawing is to expose a disturbing problem accompanying the boom of the tourism industry: the severe destruction of the environment caused by tourists’ uncivilized behaviors. With the improvement of living standards, an increasing number of people choose to travel for relaxation. Unfortunately, many of them lack a basic awareness of environmental protection. They selfishly prioritize their own convenience over the preservation of scenic spots, leaving behind tons of litter that pollutes the water and damages the fragile ecological balance.

notes.mark: a disturbing problem accompanying the boom of the tourism industry
notes.note: accompanying（伴随）一词把问题定位成「发展的副产品」，而不是孤立的坏事。这个定位让批判有了分寸——不是反对旅游，是反对不文明。

notes.mark: tourists’ uncivilized behaviors
notes.note: uncivilized behaviors（不文明行为）是公德类作文的必备定性词。把责任精确落到「行为」上，而不是笼统地骂游客。

notes.mark: many of them lack a basic awareness
notes.note: many of them 而不是 tourists——限定批判范围，避免一竿子打翻一船人。批判类文章的分寸感全在这类限定词上。

notes.mark: selfishly prioritize their own convenience over the preservation of scenic spots
notes.note: 又一次用 prioritize A over B 分析价值取舍，与 2009 年小作文同一句式。副词 selfishly 直接给动机定性。

notes.mark: the fragile ecological balance
notes.note: fragile（脆弱的）反衬破坏之易。环境类话题里，形容生态一律用 fragile、delicate 这类词，才能凸显不可逆性。

paragraphs.analysis: 主语链条：寓意 → 越来越多的人（背景）→ 他们中的许多人（缩小范围）→ 他们（批判对象）。范围一步步收紧，最后才开火，这是批判类文章避免「以偏概全」的标准做法。

paragraphs.text: In my view, it is imperative that we take immediate actions to curb this alarming trend. On the one hand, the government should enact stricter regulations and impose heavy fines on those who litter in tourist attractions. On the other hand, a nationwide educational campaign should be launched to cultivate public eco-awareness. Only when everyone behaves responsibly can we preserve the beauty of nature for future generations.

notes.mark: curb this alarming trend
notes.note: curb（遏制）比 stop 准确：趋势只能遏制，不能一刀切停。动词的精确度也是采分点。

notes.mark: enact stricter regulations and impose heavy fines
notes.note: 法律层面的两个动作：立法（enact）和执法（impose fines）。写对策不要只说「加强管理」，要落到具体动作上。

notes.mark: a nationwide educational campaign should be launched
notes.note: 教育层面用被动语态，主语是「宣传活动」本身。与法律那一条的主动语态（the government should enact）形成句式变化，避免两条对策长得一样。

notes.mark: Only when everyone behaves responsibly can we preserve
notes.note: Only when 引导的倒装，比 Only in this way 多了一个条件从句，句子更复杂也更有力。注意倒装发生在主句（can we）而不是从句。

notes.mark: for future generations
notes.note: 环境类文章的标准落点。把时间维度拉到下一代，格局立刻打开。

paragraphs.analysis: 与 2005 年一样是「法律 + 教育」的软硬组合，但句式做了变化：法律用主动、教育用被动，倒装句也从 Only in this way 换成了 Only when。同一套结构换写法，是备考时最该练的能力。

highlights.en: shockingly ... casually
highlights.zh: 令人震惊地……漫不经心地
highlights.why: 一对情绪反差的副词，写「旁观者震惊、当事人无感」的冷漠。

highlights.en: serving as a sharp and ironic pun
highlights.zh: 构成一个尖锐而讽刺的双关
highlights.why: 标题含双关时的处理方式，说明性质而不强行直译。

highlights.en: tourists’ uncivilized behaviors
highlights.zh: 游客的不文明行为
highlights.why: 公德、环保类话题的必备定性短语。

highlights.en: curb this alarming trend
highlights.zh: 遏制这一令人警醒的趋势
highlights.why: curb 比 stop 准确，趋势类问题的标准动词。

highlights.en: Only when everyone behaves responsibly can we ...
highlights.zh: 只有当每个人都负责任地行事，我们才能……
highlights.why: Only when 倒装，比 Only in this way 更复杂的收尾。

takeaway: 批判类文章的分寸全在限定词：many of them 而不是 tourists，a disturbing problem accompanying the boom 而不是 tourism is bad。先把批判范围收紧，再开火，文章才不会被判为以偏概全。
